project.title: Set Up New In-House Dental Appliance Production Line
project.objective: Plan and launch an in-house dental appliance production line in a leased industrial space, ensuring quality, safety, and cost efficiency.
deliverables: Approved layout and fit-out plan for the production facility
End-to-end production process and quality control workflow
Regulatory and health & safety compliance checklist
Pilot batch of dental appliances meeting quality criteria
constraints: Production area must fit within existing leased floor space and lease terms
Compliance with healthcare, lab, and workplace safety regulations
Limited capex budget for machinery and fit-out
Go-live for pilot batch within 30 days
Minimal disruption to other tenants and building operations
Use existing corporate procurement and vendor approval processes

risks.risk: Delays in facility fit-out and permits push back pilot production date.
risks.mitigation: Real estate manager to pre-align with building management and authorities; add buffer in schedule and track approvals weekly.

risks.risk: Installed equipment does not meet dental lab quality or regulatory standards.
risks.mitigation: Dental technician and industrial production manager to validate specs before purchase and run acceptance tests on delivery.

risks.risk: Unexpected building constraints (power, ventilation) limit equipment options.
risks.mitigation: Industrial machinery mechanic and real estate manager to perform early technical site survey and adjust layout accordingly.

risks.risk: Operating costs exceed budget due to inefficient processes.
risks.mitigation: Industrial production manager to apply lean principles, define KPIs, and run a cost review after pilot batch.

risks.risk: Health and safety non-compliance leads to inspection issues or downtime.
risks.mitigation: Create and audit a detailed HSE checklist before go-live; schedule internal pre-inspection walkthrough.]},
